package.name: group7_final
package.description: This package is designed to help a TurtleBot autonomously navigate a simulated Gazebo environment. The program consists of two nodes: 1. camera_processor: Responsible for detecting and processing parts in the environment.. 2. robot_controller: Subscribes to the processed part poses and drives the TurtleBot towards them. The robot identifies parts using camera data, calculates their positions in the world, and moves directly beneath them using a proportional controller. Once all parts are visited, the TurtleBot returns to its starting point and shuts down gracefully.
